name: Cardiff Dementia Home Care Service
description: Domiciliary care visits in the patient's own home, from 30-minute calls to several visits a day. Carers support personal care, medication prompting, meals and companionship. Workers are dementia-trained.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with a confirmed dementia diagnosis assessed as having eligible personal-care or daily-living needs under the Social Services and Well-being (Wales) Act. Suitable for mild to severe stages. Requires a social care needs assessment.
referral_process: Requires a social worker referral following a needs assessment.
capacity_notes: Typically a 1-2 week waiting list; urgent packages can sometimes be expedited.
address: Pont Y Gylaw House, Cowbridge Road, Cardiff CF11 9XB

name: Llandaff Memory Day Centre
description: A dementia-friendly day centre offering structured activities, hot meals and social contact one to five days a week. Provides supervised respite for family carers during the day.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with a dementia diagnosis, mild to moderate stage, who are mobile or wheelchair users and can be supported in a group setting. Not suitable for those requiring one-to-one nursing care.
referral_process: Social worker referral or self-referral with GP supporting information.
capacity_notes: Limited spaces; typically a 2-3 week waiting list for regular places.
address: Llandaff Day Centre, Cardiff Road, Cardiff CF5 2DR

name: Cardiff & Vale Shared Lives (Dementia)
description: Matches a person with dementia to an approved Shared Lives carer who provides support in a family home setting, either as day support, short breaks or long-term live-in arrangements.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with mild to moderate dementia who would benefit from a small, homely setting rather than a care home. Must be assessed as able to engage in a family-based arrangement. Not suitable for those needing 24-hour nursing care.
referral_process: Requires a social worker referral and a Shared Lives matching assessment.
capacity_notes: Matching can take 4-6 weeks as it depends on finding a suitable carer.
address: Shared Lives Office, County Hall, Cardiff CF10 4UW

name: REACT Dementia Crisis Response Team
description: A rapid-response team providing intensive short-term support at home to prevent hospital admission or support discharge during a crisis. Can put in same-day visits and assessment.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with dementia experiencing an acute crisis or breakdown of support, at imminent risk of hospital admission or placement. Any stage. Time-limited intervention of up to six weeks.
referral_process: Urgent referral from a social worker, GP or hospital discharge team.
capacity_notes: Immediate availability for genuine crises; intervention is short-term only.
address: REACT Team, Hospital Llandough, Penarth CF64 2XX

name: Cardiff Admiral Nurse Service
description: Specialist dementia nurses offering expert clinical advice, emotional support and help navigating services for families living with dementia. Particularly skilled with complex presentations.
eligibility_criteria: Families and carers of people with a dementia diagnosis, especially where the presentation is complex (for example Lewy body, frontotemporal, or distressing behavioural and psychological symptoms). All stages.
referral_process: GP referral, social worker referral or self-referral.
capacity_notes: Usually contacted within one week; caseload-dependent.
address: Admiral Nurse Service, Ty Mawr, Cardiff CF14 5GF

name: Ty Gwyn Residential Dementia Care Home
description: A registered residential care home specialising in dementia, providing 24-hour personal care, meals and activities in a secure, dementia-friendly environment.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with moderate to severe dementia who can no longer be safely supported at home, assessed as needing 24-hour residential (non-nursing) care. Requires a social care assessment and financial assessment.
referral_process: Social worker referral following a residential care assessment.
capacity_notes: Limited spaces; waiting list varies, currently around 3-4 weeks.
address: Ty Gwyn Care Home, Rhydypenau Road, Cardiff CF23 6PU

name: Heol Las Nursing Dementia Unit
description: A nursing home with a specialist unit for people with advanced dementia and complex health needs, providing 24-hour registered nursing care alongside personal care.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with severe dementia and significant nursing needs such as advanced frailty, pressure-area care, or complex medication. Requires a nursing needs assessment (CHC consideration) and a financial assessment.
referral_process: Social worker or hospital referral with a nursing assessment.
capacity_notes: Very limited spaces; admission depends on bed availability.
address: Heol Las Nursing Home, Fairwater, Cardiff CF5 3JT

name: Cardiff Carers Respite at Home
description: Provides planned sitting and replacement-care sessions in the patient's home so that family carers can take a break, attend appointments or rest. Flexible day and occasional overnight cover.
eligibility_criteria: Family carers of a person with dementia who are at risk of strain or breakdown. The cared-for person can be at any stage. Usually follows a carer's assessment.
referral_process: Carer's assessment via social worker, or self-referral to the carers' team.
capacity_notes: Day sessions usually available within 1-2 weeks; overnight cover is limited.
address: Carers Respite Service, Newport Road, Cardiff CF24 0DE

name: Bryn Awel Respite Care Beds
description: Short-stay residential respite beds (typically one to two weeks) giving family carers a longer break while the person with dementia is cared for in a safe residential setting.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with moderate to severe dementia whose carer needs a planned break, or for short-term recovery. Requires a social care assessment and is subject to a financial assessment.
referral_process: Social worker referral; should be booked in advance.
capacity_notes: Pre-booked stays; limited beds, book 3-4 weeks ahead where possible.
address: Bryn Awel, St Fagans Road, Cardiff CF5 3AE

name: Cardiff Telecare & Assistive Technology
description: Installs telecare equipment such as falls detectors, door sensors, medication dispensers and gas/cooker shut-off devices, linked to a 24-hour monitoring centre to support safe independent living.
eligibility_criteria: Adults living at home with risks such as falls, wandering or kitchen safety, where technology can reduce risk. Any stage where the person can tolerate the equipment. Often used alongside a care package.
referral_process: Social worker referral or self-referral; brief home assessment carried out.
capacity_notes: Installation typically within 1-2 weeks of assessment.
address: Telecare Centre, Wilcox House, Cardiff CF10 5BU

name: Cardiff Memory Support & Information Service
description: A community service offering post-diagnosis support, information sessions, peer groups and help with future planning for people recently diagnosed with dementia and their families.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with a recent or mild dementia diagnosis and their carers. Best suited to early-stage individuals who are independent and want information, peer support and planning help.
referral_process: Self-referral, GP or memory clinic referral.
capacity_notes: Open access; immediate availability for information and groups.
address: Memory Support Service, The Hayes, Cardiff CF10 1AH

name: Cardiff Dementia Befriending Service
description: Matches a trained volunteer befriender to a person with dementia for regular visits or phone calls, reducing isolation and building a trusting relationship at a gentle pace.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with dementia who are socially isolated, including those who are reluctant to accept formal care. Mild to moderate stage. No formal financial assessment required.
referral_process: Self-referral, family referral or social worker referral.
capacity_notes: Matching to a volunteer can take 2-4 weeks.
address: Befriending Service, Charles Street, Cardiff CF10 2GC

name: Cardiff Carers Support & Advice Line
description: Provides carers' assessments, emotional support, training and advice on benefits and rights for people caring for someone with dementia, including referral on to respite and other services.
eligibility_criteria: Any unpaid carer of a person with dementia in Cardiff. No diagnosis stage requirement for the cared-for person. Carers have a legal right to an assessment.
referral_process: Self-referral or referral by any professional.
capacity_notes: Advice available immediately; carers' assessments within 2-3 weeks.
address: Cardiff Carers Line, County Hall, Cardiff CF10 4UW

name: Riverside Specialist Behavioural Support Team
description: A specialist team supporting families managing distressed or challenging behaviour in dementia, offering home-based assessment, behavioural strategies and carer coaching.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with dementia presenting with behavioural and psychological symptoms such as aggression, disinhibition, exit-seeking or severe agitation. Particularly relevant to frontotemporal and Lewy body presentations. Any stage.
referral_process: Referral from a social worker, GP, Admiral Nurse or memory clinic.
capacity_notes: Initial assessment usually within 1-2 weeks for urgent behavioural concerns.
address: Riverside Behavioural Team, Riverside Clinic, Cardiff CF11 6JU

name: Cardiff Reablement at Home Service
description: A short-term, intensive support service (up to six weeks) that helps people regain skills and confidence after a hospital stay or decline, with the aim of reducing longer-term care needs.
eligibility_criteria: Adults recently discharged from hospital or following a decline, with the potential to regain independence. Suitable for mild to moderate dementia where reablement goals are realistic. Time-limited.
referral_process: Hospital discharge team or social worker referral.
capacity_notes: Usually starts within a few days of discharge; six-week limit.
address: Reablement Service, Cowbridge Road West, Cardiff CF5 4AA

name: Whitchurch Dementia Meals & Nutrition Support
description: Delivers tailored meals and provides nutrition monitoring and prompting for people with dementia at risk of poor intake, working alongside dietitians where needed.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with dementia at risk of malnutrition, weight loss or poor hydration, particularly those living alone or refusing meals. Any stage.
referral_process: Social worker, district nurse or GP referral.
capacity_notes: Meal deliveries can usually start within one week.
address: Meals & Nutrition Service, Merthyr Road, Cardiff CF14 1TL

name: Cardiff Night Owl Overnight Support
description: Provides waking-night or sleep-in carer support in the patient's home for people with dementia who are unsafe overnight, for example due to night-time wandering or frequent falls.
eligibility_criteria: Adults with dementia assessed as having significant overnight risks such as exit-seeking, wandering or repeated night falls, where daytime support alone is insufficient. Requires a needs assessment evidencing overnight risk.
referral_process: Social worker referral following a needs assessment that evidences overnight risk.
capacity_notes: Limited overnight capacity; typically a 2-4 week waiting list.
address: Night Owl Service, Newport Road, Cardiff CF24 1RA

name: Grangetown Community Dementia Hub
description: A neighbourhood drop-in hub offering dementia cafes, carer groups, gentle activities and signposting. A low-pressure way to stay socially connected without a formal care commitment.
eligibility_criteria: People with dementia and their carers at any stage, with an emphasis on early to moderate stages and those reluctant to engage with formal services. No assessment required for drop-in sessions.
referral_process: Open access; self-referral, no appointment needed.
address: Grangetown Community Hub, Clare Road, Cardiff CF11 6QP
